clauses.condition: Before invite or collection
clauses.statement: Record controller, jurisdiction, purpose-specific basis, recipients and notice version; show the participant the current notice.
clauses.required_evidence: approved basis/notice digest and display receipt
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When challenge access is offered
clauses.statement: Do not infer optional research, follow-up, subgroup or model-training permission from challenge participation.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a purpose or recipient changes
clauses.statement: Issue a new notice and purpose decision before using existing data for the new purpose.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before real collection
clauses.statement: Approve a data-class and purpose retention schedule with trigger, duration, derivatives, backups and exception handling.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: At expiry or accepted deletion request
clauses.statement: Propagate deletion or restriction through source, derivatives, exports and vendor outputs with receipts.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a deletion job is queued or a retention value is unknown
clauses.statement: Do not report deletion complete or treat a software default as an approved retention period.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before case exposure
clauses.statement: Publish a versioned matrix for notes, internet, IDE, AI preparation, live AI, human help and accessibility tools for each session and research arm.
clauses.required_evidence: shown policy version and allowed-help pin
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a focus, visibility or fullscreen event occurs
clauses.statement: Do not infer dishonesty, reduce a score or reject a response from that event alone.
clauses.required_evidence: absence of punitive flag in score path
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.
open_parameters: any later enforcement threshold and validation

clauses.condition: When controlled assistance research is conducted
clauses.statement: Separate assigned, declared and observed conditions; keep unknown provenance unknown and disclose any telemetry purpose.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: At scored session start
clauses.statement: Pin case, rubric, help rule, response mode, reveal schedule and original server deadline.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: After capture, reveal or upload failure
clauses.statement: Apply the pinned Recovery Rule and preserve evidence; resume the same finished bytes when valid.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a connection falls or a browser event fires
clauses.statement: Do not silently create a new case, reset the ten-minute clock or turn a technical void into a zero rating.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before releasing an assessment mode
clauses.statement: Test the browser journey and response alternatives with declared accessibility criteria and affected users.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a participant cannot use video, blur or a timed interaction as offered
clauses.statement: Provide a documented non-punitive alternate/accommodation route and preserve its response-mode label.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a mode or assistive tool differs
clauses.statement: Do not treat device/mode failure or assistive technology as low ability or assistance evidence.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before a case can be assigned
clauses.statement: Complete independent case review, mechanism similarity check, rubric compatibility and exact release disposition.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: After exposure, flaw or changed requirements
clauses.statement: Track form exposure and retire, repair or re-evaluate under a successor version.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a generator produces a prompt or a retry is needed
clauses.statement: Do not use an unreviewed generated case as a scored form or automatic replacement.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before publishing feedback
clauses.statement: Pin case/rubric/transcript/scorer versions, source spans, independent human review and adjudication state.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: In the mixed-developer pilot
clauses.statement: Do not show rank, percentile, global readiness, hiring recommendation or hidden research score as validated ability.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When evidence is missing, corrected or contested
clauses.statement: Use NA/UNK/pending correctly, preserve predecessor ratings and issue a successor report only after review.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before invitations or randomization
clauses.statement: Register cohort, recruitment source, inclusion/exclusion, cases, assignment probabilities, outcomes, precision and stopping rules.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: During assignment and analysis
clauses.statement: Preserve assignment probabilities, deviations, attrition and denominators; distinguish mixed-developer usability from role-specific hiring validation.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: After seeing responses
clauses.statement: Do not change primary allocation, thresholds or holdout membership without a declared amendment and separate analysis.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before extraction or downstream use
clauses.statement: Recheck current purpose eligibility, withdrawal, retention and fields for the exact recipient and protocol.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: For challenge-only answers
clauses.statement: Do not use recordings or transcripts for optional research, training or vendor improvement without the separately authorized purpose.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: After withdrawal or correction
clauses.statement: Track all extracts and descendants, revoke future use and record feasible deletion or documented exception.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: For every protected read, write or export
clauses.statement: Evaluate the active role, object, purpose and guard; log the allow/deny result without secrets or answer text.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.
open_parameters: named principals and active policy version

clauses.condition: On custody leak, unauthorized access or critical security incident
clauses.statement: Contain affected processing and route incident classification and notification to accountable owners.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.
open_parameters: jurisdiction-specific notice duties and response targets

clauses.condition: For exceptional raw media access
clauses.statement: Do not self-grant or use standing broad access; require scoped ticket, separate approval, expiry and use receipt.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before a service receives participant data
clauses.statement: Pin legal recipient, data fields, region, terms, subprocessors, retention/deletion, security review and an owner Decision.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before packaging a library or SDK
clauses.statement: Pin exact version, license, upstream identity, security and maintenance posture, and rollback path.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a shortlist or option review names a product
clauses.statement: Do not treat a product name or provisional preference as approved processing or a deployed binding.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a participant requests access, correction, withdrawal or deletion
clauses.statement: Verify identity proportionately, record affected lineage, decision, execution and response receipt.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When feedback evidence or a transcript is contested
clauses.statement: Preserve the original, review source media only by authorized purpose, and issue a versioned correction or reasoned rejection.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When a request is pending
clauses.statement: Do not claim completed correction or deletion from a queued job or hide a documented exception.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before role-specific prospective validation
clauses.statement: Do not advertise scores from three answers as identifying the best engineers or enable employer selection.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: For every score or study claim
clauses.statement: Name population, role, outcome, comparator, uncertainty, evidence tier and approved wording.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before any employment-use release
clauses.statement: Obtain a separate owner decision, legal/accessibility review, applicant-like validation and monitoring policy for the exact role and use.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: When scale cost, feature, API, quality, privacy or operational assumptions change
clauses.statement: Register the affected binding/decision, trigger, evidence and interim handling through the Challenge Contract.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before replacing an integration
clauses.statement: Compare incumbent and alternatives under current requirements, rerun affected checks and record a new Decision and successor binding.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: On filing a challenge alone
clauses.statement: Do not silently suspend or replace the current integration without the applicable owner and incident decision.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before research enrollment
clauses.statement: Register participant burden, risk, compensation, withdrawal route, support contact and whether independent ethics review is required for the selected setting.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.
open_parameters: ethics route, compensation and support owner

clauses.condition: Before publishing any study output
clauses.statement: Review aggregation, small-cell and quotation reidentification risks; publish only within the approved protocol and participant notice.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: After a rubric, ASR or scorer version changes
clauses.statement: Re-evaluate affected cases, response modes and locked human holdouts before promoting a successor score or feedback policy.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.

clauses.condition: Before pilot release and after material recovery change
clauses.statement: Test database, media and backup restoration together with deletion tombstones and rights lineage before resuming collection.
clauses.exception_route: Named policy owner plus documented exception and independent review where the protected purpose or data changes.
